blocks.source: ３ＤＳ版との同時発売だが、筆者はＰＳ４版でプレイ。ちなみに、前作に当たるオンラインのＤＱ１０は未プレイで書いているので、前提として注意を。
blocks.translation: Although it was released simultaneously with the 3DS version, I played the PS4 version. Incidentally, I had not played the online DQX, which was the preceding title, so please keep that in mind as a premise.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: クエストを全てこなしながら、本編クリアまで６６時間。
blocks.translation: It took 66 hours to clear the main story while completing every quest.

blocks.source: さらには裏ボス撃破まで９０時間と、シリーズではＤＱ７以来のプレイ時間だった。サブイベントを全てこなせば、１００時間は遊べるかもしれない。マップが広大ということもあるけれど、同系統のＤＱ８を凌駕する質量がある。
blocks.translation: It took 90 hours to defeat the superboss, making it the longest I had played in the series since DQ7. If you complete all the side events, you might be able to play for 100 hours. The map is vast, but the game also has more content than the similar DQ8.

blocks.source: 本編が呆気なく終わったＤＱ９と比較して、その倍ぐらいの規模はあるかも。正直言って、ここまで作り込んでくるとは思わなかった。
blocks.translation: Compared with DQ9, whose main story ended rather abruptly, it may be about twice the size. To be honest, I never expected it to be this thoroughly developed.

blocks.source: ストーリーとしては、久々となる主人公が勇者のドラクエ。それも今回は、序盤から主人公が勇者であることが明示されている。この種の設定は何気にファミコンのＤＱ４以来となる。
blocks.translation: As for the story, this is the first Dragon Quest in a while with a Luminary protagonist. This time, it is explicitly established from the beginning that the protagonist is the Luminary. This kind of setup has not appeared since the NES version of DQ4.

blocks.source: ＤＱ６以降、起伏の控えめなストーリーが続いていた本シリーズだけど、今回は印象の強いイベントが多かった。
blocks.translation: Although this series had continued with relatively low-key stories since DQ6, this time there were many memorable events.

blocks.source: 特に仲間達に関わるイベントが充実しており、魅力的な仲間達との冒険を演出してくれている。主人公の頼れる相棒カミュ、それぞれ重要な役割を果たすベロニカとセーニャの姉妹、オネエキャラながら芯の強いところを見せるシルビア。
blocks.translation: The events involving the companions in particular are substantial, creating an adventure with a captivating cast. There is the protagonist's dependable partner, Erik; the sisters Veronica and Serena, who each play important roles; and Sylvando, a flamboyant character who nevertheless shows great inner strength.

blocks.source: ……などなど、キャラクター性は過去のドラクエのどれよりも高い。王道のドラクエにしては珍しく、先が気になるストーリーになっている。
blocks.translation: …and so on. The characters are more distinctive than in any previous Dragon Quest. Unusually for a traditional Dragon Quest title, it has a story that keeps you wondering what will happen next.

blocks.source: ネタバレを徹底的に避けていた甲斐もあって、本編後半の展開には驚かされた。本作ではこの辺りのストーリーが最も強く印象に残った。
blocks.translation: Avoiding spoilers so thoroughly paid off, as I was surprised by the developments in the latter half of the main story. This part of the story left the strongest impression on me in this game.

blocks.source: クリア後の裏面も相当な量がある。物語的に大きな伏線回収がなされるため、クリア後も実質的な本編と言えるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: There is also a considerable amount of content after clearing the game. Since major story foreshadowing is resolved there, it could practically be considered part of the main story even after the credits.

blocks.source: ただし、そこからは急激に水で薄めたような内容になるのが難点。一度クリアしたダンジョンを再度もぐらせるようなものが多く、イベント内容も急に味気なくなる。
blocks.translation: The problem, however, is that the content suddenly becomes watered down from that point on. Many sections make you revisit dungeons you have already cleared, and the events suddenly become bland as well.

blocks.source: ネタバレになるので詳しく書けないけれど、充実した本編との落差で少しばかり寂しい気分になった。裏面突入時は展開の壮大さもあって、ワクワクしたのだけど……。
blocks.translation: I cannot go into detail because it would be a spoiler, but the contrast with the substantial main story left me feeling a little lonely. I was excited when entering the post-game story because of the epic developments, though…

blocks.source: 何はともあれ、真エンドの演出はシリーズファンをうならせるものがある。性質上、今回は裏ボスまで倒さない限りストーリーを終えたことにはならない。
blocks.translation: In any case, the presentation of the true ending is sure to impress series fans. By its nature, the story cannot really be considered finished this time unless you defeat the superboss.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Usability

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: 進化してはいるけれど、いつものドラクエ。昔ながらのコマンド式。
blocks.translation: It has evolved, but it is still the Dragon Quest you know. The traditional command-based system.

blocks.source: 古臭いという意見もあるけれど、ドラクエはこれでよいと思う。
blocks.translation: Some people may consider it outdated, but I think Dragon Quest is fine this way.

blocks.source: 例えば、アクション式だと主人公一人しか操作できないことが多い。
blocks.translation: For example, action-based systems often allow you to control only the protagonist.

blocks.source: 対して、コマンド式は仲間全員へ指示できるため、細かい戦術も可能となる。仲間を操作するために、愛着が湧きやすいことも利点となる。
blocks.translation: By contrast, a command-based system lets you give orders to all your companions, enabling detailed tactics. Being able to control your companions also makes it easier to grow attached to them.

blocks.source: また、リアルタイム性がないため、気を抜いて気楽にできることも大きい。作戦を指示してＡＩに任せるも、自分で操作するも、プレイスタイルは自由。
blocks.translation: Also, since it is not real-time, it is much easier to play casually without having to stay constantly focused. You can give orders to the AI and let it handle things, or control the characters yourself—the play style is up to you.

blocks.source: そう考えてみれば、古典的でありながら、意外と今の時代に合っているような気もしないでもない。
blocks.translation: When you think about it that way, it is surprisingly well suited to the modern era despite being so classic.

blocks.source: ……というように、コマンド式を愛好する側から擁護してみた。
blocks.translation: …That is how I defended the command-based system from the perspective of someone who enjoys it.

blocks.source: 変わったところでは、コマンド入力と行動がターンでまとめてではなく、一人ずつ実行されるようになった。
blocks.translation: One change is that command input and actions are now carried out one character at a time instead of being grouped together into a single turn.

blocks.source: どうやらＰＳ４版だけの仕様らしく、最初はこれにとまどった。
blocks.translation: Apparently this is a feature exclusive to the PS4 version, and it confused me at first.

blocks.source: 「まさか、ＣＴＢか何かになって、ターン制ではなくなったのか？」
blocks.translation: "Surely it has become some kind of CTB system, meaning it is no longer turn-based?"

blocks.source: と、疑って検証してみたけれど、やっぱり行動順序はターン制のままだった。
blocks.translation: I suspected as much and tested it, but the order of actions was still turn-based after all.

blocks.source: 相変わらず行動順序にランダム性があるため、運が悪いと連続でボスの攻撃を喰らってしまうことも。この辺りのルールは少し分かりにくいと感じた。
blocks.translation: Since the order of actions remains random, bad luck can sometimes leave you taking consecutive attacks from a boss. I found the rules in this area a little difficult to understand.

blocks.source: また、ダメージを受けてターンが回ってくると、確率でキャラが『ゾーン』という強化状態になる。
blocks.translation: Also, when a character takes damage and their turn comes around, they have a chance of entering an enhanced state called “Zone.”

blocks.source: さらに複数人がゾーン状態になれば『れんけい』が使える。……が、これらはランダム性が高く戦術に組み込みにくい。ボス戦のような過酷な場面で狙って発動するのは至難の業。戦術に組み込めるとしても、かなり終盤になるのではないだろうか。
blocks.translation: Furthermore, when multiple characters are in Zone, you can use “Pep Powers.” …However, these are highly random and difficult to incorporate into your tactics. Deliberately activating them in difficult situations such as boss battles is extremely challenging. Even if you can incorporate them into your strategy, it probably will not be until quite late in the game.

blocks.source: 今回からは、レベルアップ時にＨＰＭＰが全快する仕様になっている。
blocks.translation: Starting with this game, HP and MP are fully restored when you level up.

blocks.source: また、フィールドやダンジョンの要所にはキャンプ地点があり、そこでも回復が可能になっている。キャンプではセーブなどの施設も使用できるのでとても便利。
blocks.translation: There are also camps at key locations in fields and dungeons, where you can recover as well. Camps are very convenient because they also offer facilities such as saving.

blocks.source: そのため、パーティの消耗は今までのシリーズ作品よりかなりゆるい。ありがたいといえばありがたいけれど、戦闘の度に大技をぶっ放すような大味なプレイになる傾向も。
blocks.translation: As a result, the party's attrition is much less severe than in previous games in the series. It is certainly welcome, but it also tends to encourage a blunt play style in which you unleash powerful attacks in every battle.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８の錬金に代わって今作には『不思議な鍛冶』がある。それで装備を作成できることもあって、お金も不足しにくい。
blocks.translation: Instead of DQ8's alchemy, this game has the “Fun-Size Forge.” Since you can use it to create equipment, money is also less likely to run short.

blocks.source: それらもあって、序盤～中盤と難易度は低め。今回はボス戦の経験値が多めなので、レベル上げをせずとも問題なく進めた。
blocks.translation: Because of these features, the difficulty is relatively low in the early to middle portions of the game. Boss battles provide a generous amount of experience this time, so I was able to progress without grinding levels.

blocks.source: もっとも、難易度は比較的低いという程度でＳＦＣ版ＤＱ３やＤＱ９よりは難しいはず。
blocks.translation: That said, “relatively low” is all that can be said about the difficulty; it should still be harder than the SFC version of DQ3 and DQ9.

blocks.source: さらには、本編後半からはボス敵の攻撃が激しくなってくる。三回攻撃や全体状態異常を当たり前に繰り出してくるためなかなか厳しい。特にドラクエの場合、異常を完全に防ぐことは難しいので運ゲーになることも。
blocks.translation: Furthermore, boss attacks become more intense in the latter half of the main story. They routinely unleash three attacks or status ailments affecting the entire party, making things quite difficult. In Dragon Quest especially, it is hard to completely prevent status ailments, so battles can sometimes come down to luck.

blocks.source: 今作の不満点の一つとして、戦闘テンポが挙げられる。
blocks.translation: One of the game's shortcomings is its battle tempo.

blocks.source: 今時のＲＰＧにしては戦闘がゆったりしていて、ＤＱ８の時代から余り進歩が見られない。
blocks.translation: The battles are sluggish for a modern RPG, showing little progress from the days of DQ8.

blocks.source: 戦闘開始まで７秒。ＰＳ３以降のＲＰＧとしてはやや長い。
blocks.translation: Seven seconds until the battle starts. That's rather long for an RPG from the PS3 era onward.

blocks.source: 敵と距離があると、攻撃する度にノロノロと敵へ近づく。
blocks.translation: When there is some distance from an enemy, the character slowly approaches it each time they attack.

blocks.source: 呪文や特技には微妙な溜めのモーションがある。特に『ぶんまわし』のような単純な技にまで、数秒程度の溜めモーションは過剰では？
blocks.translation: Spells and Techs have subtle charge-up animations. Even for simple abilities like “Whirlwind,” isn't a charge-up animation lasting several seconds excessive?

blocks.source: 防御して次ターンが回ってきた時にいちいち「守りをといた」のメッセージ。
blocks.translation: Whenever the next turn comes around after defending, there is an unnecessary “Dropped their guard” message.

blocks.source: ＨＰ・ＭＰ自動回復だと毎ターンメッセージを待たされる。
blocks.translation: With automatic HP and MP recovery, you have to wait for a message every turn.

blocks.source: 全体的に、いちいち行動が終わるまで待つのは時代遅れ感が否めない。
blocks.translation: Overall, having to wait for every action to finish feels undeniably outdated.

blocks.source: 例えば、通常攻撃の速度を比較すると、こんな感じ。
blocks.translation: For example, comparing the speed of normal attacks, it looks like this.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版ＤＱ３ ：１．５秒
blocks.translation: SFC version of DQ3: 1.5 seconds

blocks.source: ＰＳ２版ＤＱ５ ：１．０秒
blocks.translation: PS2 version of DQ5: 1.0 second

blocks.source: ＰＳ２版ＤＱ８ ：３．０秒
blocks.translation: PS2 version of DQ8: 3.0 seconds

blocks.source: ＰＳ４版ＤＱ１１：２．５秒
blocks.translation: PS4 version of DQ11: 2.5 seconds

blocks.source: システムは古いままでよいと言ったけれど、ここは頑張って欲しかった。今はグラフィックの綺麗なＲＰＧでも、これよりテンポの優れたものはいくらでもある。
blocks.translation: I said it was fine for the system to remain old-fashioned, but I wish they had made more of an effort here. These days, there are plenty of RPGs with beautiful graphics that have a better pace than this.

blocks.source: というか、ＰＳ２版ＤＱ５の時点ではテンポ良すぎて気持ち悪いレベルだったのに、なんで退化してるんでしょうか……。
blocks.translation: In fact, the PS2 version of DQ5 was already at an almost uncomfortably fast pace, so why has it regressed…?

blocks.source: 余談。ここまで検証していて気づいたけれど『フリー移動バトル』モードのほうがテンポが若干早いような気がする……。なぜか「守りをといた」や「ＨＰ・ＭＰ自動回復」のメッセージが飛ばせるようになった。並行して処理を行うようにプログラムされているせいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: As an aside, while testing this, I noticed that the “Free Movement Battle” mode seems to have a slightly faster pace… For some reason, it became possible to skip messages such as “Dropped their guard” and “Automatic HP and MP recovery.” This may be because it is programmed to process them concurrently.

blocks.source: ともあれ、昨今のゲームはあれこれと複雑なシステムを組み込んだ結果、逆に面白さが迷子になっていることが多い印象がある。それと比較すれば、ドラクエの面白さはとても明快。本作ももちろん堅実に楽しめる仕上がりになっている。
blocks.translation: In any case, my impression is that many modern games have incorporated various complicated systems and, as a result, have lost sight of what makes them fun. Compared to those, Dragon Quest’s appeal is very straightforward. This title, too, is a solid and enjoyable experience.

blocks.source: その他ゲームバランスについて細かいこと。
blocks.translation: A few other details about the game balance.

blocks.source: メラ・ヒャド系呪文が微妙に弱い。敵の耐性の関係もあってか、単体攻撃のメラゾーマより全体攻撃のイオナズンのほうが期待値が高い気がする。消費ＭＰは大差ないのに……。
blocks.translation: Mer and Hyado-type spells are slightly weak. Perhaps because of enemy resistances, I feel that the overall-damage spell Ionazun has a higher expected value than the single-target spell Merazoma. Even though their MP costs are not significantly different…

blocks.source: 敵の強さと経験値が釣り合ってないことが多い。基本的に少数で出現する巨大な強敵より、群れを作るザコを狙ったほうが効率がよい。これは今までのシリーズにもあったことだけど、今回は大型の強敵が多いので特に気になった。
blocks.translation: Enemy strength and experience points are often poorly balanced. In general, it is more efficient to target the weak enemies that appear in groups than the gigantic, powerful enemies that appear in small numbers. This has also occurred in previous games in the series, but it stood out especially this time because there are so many large, powerful enemies.

blocks.source: 主人公の最強剣技が案外弱く、中盤で覚えられる技にすら負けているのはどうなのか。
blocks.translation: The protagonist’s strongest sword technique is surprisingly weak, even losing out to techniques learned midway through the game. How does that make sense?

blocks.source: ボス戦の経験値が多めなのはよいけど、死んでいるキャラは経験値が入らない。控えのキャラのほうがレベルが上がりやすい逆転現象も。
blocks.translation: It is good that boss battles provide a generous amount of experience, but dead characters do not receive any. There is even an odd reversal where reserve characters are more likely to level up.

blocks.source: 成長システム
blocks.translation: Growth System

blocks.source: 選んだスキルと隣接したスキルが解放されていくパネル形式。
blocks.translation: A panel-based system in which selected skills and adjacent skills are unlocked.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８のスキルマスターの発展系だが、それよりもスキルの数は豊富。ＦＦ１０のスフィア板などと似たものになっている。
blocks.translation: It is an evolution of DQ8’s Skill Master system, but it offers a greater variety of skills. It is similar to the Sphere Grid in FF10.

blocks.source: 例えば、カミュは『片手剣』『短剣』『ブーメラン』『かみわざ』の四通りのスキルがある。
blocks.translation: For example, Camus has four skill paths: “One-Handed Swords,” “Knives,” “Boomerangs,” and “Nimbleness.”

blocks.source: 単体攻撃が強力だが、全体攻撃ができない『片手剣』
blocks.translation: “One-Handed Swords,” with powerful single-target attacks but no way to attack groups

blocks.source: 強力な全体攻撃が可能だが、硬い敵が苦手な『ブーメラン』
blocks.translation: “Boomerangs,” which allow powerful group attacks but are ineffective against heavily armored enemies

blocks.source: というように選んだスキルによって、成長の方向性が変わってくる。パーティ編成とスキル次第で、ＤＱ８よりもプレイヤーごとの個性を出しやすい。
blocks.translation: Thus, the direction of growth changes depending on the skills you choose. Depending on your party composition and skills, it is easier to express individual player preferences than in DQ8.

blocks.source: スキルは中盤～後半辺りからリセットも可能。
blocks.translation: Skills can also be reset from around the middle to the latter half of the game.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８ではやり直しができなかったため、地雷スキルを選ぶと大きく不利になったが、今回はその心配は少ない。リセットにはわずかなお金（Ｇ）が取られるだけなのは助かる。
blocks.translation: In DQ8, you could not redo your choices, so selecting a bad skill put you at a major disadvantage. This time, there is less need to worry about that. It is helpful that resetting costs only a small amount of money (G).

blocks.source: その他
blocks.translation: Other

blocks.source: 色々と快適にプレイさせるための工夫がされている。
blocks.translation: Various measures have been implemented to make the game more comfortable to play.

blocks.source: メニューを開いて□ボタンを押すだけで、『ほぼまんたん』で自動的に回復してくれる。
blocks.translation: Simply open the menu and press the □ button to automatically recover using “Almost Full.”

blocks.source: 地図画面や仲間との会話で、行き先を逐一教えてくれる。
blocks.translation: The map screen and conversations with party members explain your destination every step of the way.

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントなので敵を避けやすい。
blocks.translation: Because encounters are symbol-based, it is easy to avoid enemies.

blocks.source: メニュー画面の操作が洗練されていて動作も軽快。
blocks.translation: The menu controls are polished, and the interface is responsive.

blocks.source: 特に『ほぼまんたん』は非常に便利。既存シリーズの『まんたん』よりも賢くやってくれるので、ＭＰ消費の心配は薄い。ＲＰＧお決まりの回復作業から一気に解放してくれる。
blocks.translation: “Almost Full” is especially convenient. It handles things more intelligently than the existing series’ “Full Recovery,” so there is little need to worry about MP consumption. It frees you from the routine healing chores typical of RPGs all at once.

blocks.source: 気になるロード時間だが、これはＤＱ８の時代より悪化している。ゲーム機は二世代も進化したはずなのに、いまだロード地獄からプレイヤーは解放してもらえないらしい……。
blocks.translation: As for the loading times, which are a concern, they are worse than in the era of DQ8. Game consoles should have advanced by two generations, yet it seems players still have not been freed from loading hell…

blocks.source: マップ切り替えに１０～２０秒程度。
blocks.translation: About 10–20 seconds to change maps.

blocks.source: ルーラに２５秒。
blocks.translation: Twenty-five seconds for Zoom.

blocks.source: 空の乗り物へ乗るには２５秒、降りるのに十数秒。
blocks.translation: Twenty-five seconds to board a flying vehicle, and more than ten seconds to get off.

blocks.source: ただし、マップ内へ一度入ってしまえば細かいロードは少ない。少なくとも、民家の出入りだけでロードが発生するようなことはない。数十分の町探索中、一度もロードがないこともあるので、良心的な部類かも。
blocks.translation: However, once you enter a map, there are few minor loading pauses. At least entering and leaving houses does not trigger loading. There are even times when you can explore a town for several dozen minutes without loading once, so it may be relatively considerate.

blocks.source: ロード回数を軽減するためか、ルーラがダンジョン内でも使用可能になっている。（ＰＳ４版限定とか）また、各地のキャンプ地点まで直接ルーラ可能になっているのは便利。
blocks.translation: Perhaps to reduce the number of loading screens, Zoom can also be used inside dungeons. (Apparently this may be limited to the PS4 version.) It is also convenient that you can Zoom directly to campsites in various locations.

blocks.source: また、マップは広めだが、ＤＱ８よりは全体的に抑えられている。ただし、移動速度は遅めだし、町の構造は複雑なので、疲れを感じる人は多いと思う。フィールド上では乗り物も使えるのでさして問題ないが、町中はそれなりに大変。
blocks.translation: The maps are fairly large, but overall more restrained than in DQ8. However, movement speed is on the slow side and towns have complex layouts, so I think many people will find it tiring. Vehicles can be used in the field, so it is not much of a problem there, but getting around towns can be fairly demanding.

blocks.source: 特に今回はメダル王に当たる施設が微妙に遠い。メダルを渡しに行くのにルーラから合算して、一分もかかったりするのは何とかして欲しかった。
blocks.translation: This time in particular, the facility corresponding to the Medal King is somewhat far away. I wish they had done something about the fact that going to hand over medals could take a full minute, including the time from using Zoom.

blocks.source: 今作もＤＱ９から引き続きクエストが存在する。
blocks.translation: This game also continues the quest system introduced in DQ9.

blocks.source: 内容としては、ＤＱ９のように目立って面倒なものは控えめ。攻略情報なしでも大半はどうにかなった。……が、数点面倒になって攻略に頼った。マップが広いため、捜し物を見落とすとかなり面倒なことになる。
blocks.translation: In terms of content, there are relatively few conspicuously tedious quests like those in DQ9. I managed to complete most of them without a walkthrough. …However, a few became troublesome enough that I had to rely on one. Because the maps are large, overlooking something you need to find can become quite a hassle.

blocks.source: それ以外だと……
blocks.translation: Other than that…

blocks.source: 『れんけい』によって特定の敵を倒せ
blocks.translation: Defeat a specific enemy using “Pep Powers”

blocks.source: 同じ敵を何度も倒せば登場する転生モンスターを倒せ
blocks.translation: Defeat a re-incarnated monster that appears after defeating the same enemy repeatedly

blocks.source: カジノのルーレットでジャックポットを当てろ
blocks.translation: Hit the jackpot at the casino roulette

blocks.source: この三種類は特に面倒だった。いずれも運の要素が絡んでくるため、当たりを引くまで繰り返さなければならない。戦闘関連もテンポがあまりよくないため面倒になってしまう。
blocks.translation: These three were particularly troublesome. Since luck is involved in all of them, you have to repeat them until you get the desired result. The battle-related ones are also tedious because the pacing isn't very good.

blocks.source: その他、気になった点としては……
blocks.translation: Other points that caught my attention were…

blocks.source: マップ上で○ボタンで魔物にアタックすると有利になるが、乗り物上からできない。
blocks.translation: Attacking monsters with the ○ button on the map gives you an advantage, but you can't do it while riding a vehicle.

blocks.source: 魔物に対して遠距離から○ボタンを押せば、ボウガンで敵をおびき寄せることができる。……が、これがアタックの誤操作などで頻繁に暴発する。そもそも、ボウガン自体が不要な気がする。
blocks.translation: Pressing the ○ button from a distance while facing a monster lets you lure it with a crossbow. …However, this frequently goes off accidentally, such as when you misinput an attack. In the first place, I feel the crossbow itself is unnecessary.

blocks.source: 明らかに格下のザコに対しても逃走に失敗する。
blocks.translation: You can even fail to escape from clearly inferior small fry.

blocks.source: 船だけは旧来のランダムエンカウント。しかも出現率が高め。
blocks.translation: Only the ship uses the old random encounters. What's more, the encounter rate is rather high.

blocks.source: 後はストーリーに関しても書いたけれど、クリア後の密度の低さは如何ともしがたい。
blocks.translation: As I also mentioned regarding the story, there is unfortunately no way around how sparse the post-game content is.

blocks.source: イベントの密度、ほどほどの敵の強さ、新しい敵とダンジョン……。そういったものが合わさって、ドラクエの面白さは構成されているのだと思う。
blocks.translation: The density of events, enemies of moderate strength, new enemies and dungeons… I think Dragon Quest's appeal is built from these elements coming together.

blocks.source: 本編に関してはそれらが申し分なく発揮されていた。
blocks.translation: In the main story, these elements were all delivered flawlessly.

blocks.source: ところが裏面においては……
blocks.translation: However, in the post-game…

blocks.source: イベントは呆気なく終わる
blocks.translation: Events end abruptly

blocks.source: 急激に強くなる敵に苦しめられる
blocks.translation: You struggle against enemies that suddenly become much stronger

blocks.source: 見たことのある敵やダンジョンが再登場する
blocks.translation: Enemies and dungeons you've already seen reappear

blocks.source: というように、どうしてもモチベーションが下がってしまう。
blocks.translation: As a result, your motivation inevitably drops.

blocks.source: 今回は裏面が明確にストーリーへ組み込まれているため、ストーリー重視のプレイヤーも無視はできない。
blocks.translation: Since the post-game is clearly incorporated into the story this time, even players who prioritize the story can't simply ignore it.

blocks.source: 本編と同じような勢いのまま、終われたら理想だったのに――と、個人的には思ってしまった。
blocks.translation: Personally, I couldn't help thinking that it would have been ideal if it had ended with the same momentum as the main story――.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 事前情報の段階だと、キャラはパッとしない印象があったのだけど、実際に動いているところを見れば、思った以上に魅力的。ベロニカなんかは、とても表情豊かで細かい顔芸が楽しい。
blocks.translation: Based on the pre-release information, the characters had struck me as rather unremarkable, but seeing them actually in motion, they were more appealing than I expected. Veronica in particular is extremely expressive, and her subtle facial expressions are a lot of fun.

blocks.source: 大ガラス、フロッガー、リップス、おばけキノコ、ドロル、ももんじゃ、マムーとモンスターのチョイスがなつかしい。
blocks.translation: The monster selection is nostalgic, with Great Ravens, Floggers, Lips, Walking Mushrooms, Drohls, Momonjas, and Mamu.

blocks.source: モンスターズなどの外伝を除けば、単一作品にしか登場しない魔物の再登場が多い。
blocks.translation: Aside from spin-offs such as Dragon Quest Monsters, many monsters that appeared in only one particular game have returned.

blocks.source: ２以来の再登場となるスモークなんかは、今の技術で表現したらこうなるんだというのを見せてくれた。
blocks.translation: Smoke, returning for the first time since II, showed me what it would look like rendered with modern technology.

blocks.source: ドラゴンやクラーゴンなど、旧作では小さなドットだったモンスターが迫力ある姿になったのは嬉しい。
blocks.translation: It was nice to see monsters such as dragons and Kragons, which were just tiny sprites in the older games, become imposing creatures.

blocks.source: 一説によると、ＤＱ１０からの流用が多いらしいけれど、初見の身にとっては大いに感激させられた。
blocks.translation: Apparently, many of them were reused from Dragon Quest X, but as someone seeing them for the first time, I was deeply impressed.

blocks.source: もっとも、本作オリジナルモンスターは乏しいし、後半は同じ魔物の使い回しが目立つのが難点なのだけど……。
blocks.translation: That said, the game has few original monsters, and the reuse of the same monsters becomes especially noticeable in the latter half, which is a drawback…

blocks.source: 西洋風、和風、琉球風――と町の種類も様々。
blocks.translation: The towns also come in a variety of styles: Western, Japanese, Ryukyuan, and more――.

blocks.source: 今時、これよりグラフィックの質が高い作品はいくらでもあるけれど、こちらはバリエーションの豊かさが強み。何より、温かみのあるドラクエ世界を良質なグラフィックで遊べることが嬉しい。
blocks.translation: These days, there are plenty of games with better-quality graphics, but this game's strength lies in its variety. More than anything, I was happy to be able to experience the warm world of Dragon Quest with high-quality graphics.

blocks.source: 以前プレイした某洋ゲ―はグラフィックは綺麗なのだけど、雰囲気は暗いし、同じような敵や地形ばかりで飽きてしまった覚えがある。こういうＪＲＰＧの強みは今後とも大事にして欲しい。
blocks.translation: I remember playing a certain Western game before that had beautiful graphics, but its atmosphere was gloomy, and I grew tired of seeing nothing but similar enemies and terrain. I hope the strengths of JRPGs like this continue to be valued.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: フィールド曲、戦闘曲、町の曲、ダンジョン曲と、無難なすぎやま節といった感じ。強い印象はないのだけど安定している。
blocks.translation: The field, battle, town, and dungeon music all have a safe, conventional Sugiyama feel. They don't leave a strong impression, but they are consistently solid.

blocks.source: その中では、シルビアのテーマとして流れるパレード曲だけが、悪目立ちしていてちょっとしつこいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Among them, only the parade music played as Sylvia's theme stands out in a bad way and may be a little grating.

blocks.source: 新曲で最もよかったのは、要所で流れるハープ曲。特にセーニャに関わるシーンが印象深い。中盤までは「姉妹の影が薄いほう」という印象だったけど、思ったよりヒロインしていてよかった。
blocks.translation: The best of the new songs is the harp piece that plays at key moments. The scenes involving Serena in particular left a strong impression. Until around the middle of the game, I thought of her as “the less prominent of the sisters,” but she turned out to be more of a heroine than I expected, which was nice.

blocks.source: ただ、今作は音楽の使い回しが多くて、新曲の印象がとにかく薄い。集大成ということもあってか、本作は過去作からの音楽の流用がとても多いのが特徴になっている。
blocks.translation: However, this game reuses so much music that the new songs leave virtually no impression. Perhaps because it is intended as a culmination of the series, one of its defining characteristics is how much music it borrows from previous games.

blocks.source: なつかしさは感じられるし、場面に合っていることが多いのも確か。久しぶりに聞いた人なら感激できることも多いはず。
blocks.translation: It certainly evokes nostalgia, and it is also true that the music often suits the scenes. Those hearing it again after a long time will probably find many moments to be deeply moving.

blocks.source: そこまではいいのだけど、まさかゲームの要となる箇所までも、過去作の流用ばかりだとは思わなかった。
blocks.translation: Up to that point, it was fine, but I never expected even the game's key moments to rely almost entirely on music borrowed from previous titles.

blocks.source: 一例を挙げれば、本作の船の曲『海図を広げて』は元々ＤＱ４に使われていた曲。ＤＱ９にも使われているので、二作連続で独自の船曲が存在しないことになる。名曲かもしれないけれど、『ＤＱ１１の船の曲』が存在しないという事実はもったいない。
blocks.translation: For example, this game's ship theme, “Spread Out the Sea Chart,” was originally used in Dragon Quest IV. Since it was also used in Dragon Quest IX, that means two consecutive games have lacked an original ship theme. It may be a masterpiece, but it is a shame that there is no such thing as “Dragon Quest XI's ship theme.”

blocks.source: ※ちなみにＤＱ１０はそもそも船がないらしいです。
blocks.translation: ※Incidentally, it seems Dragon Quest X doesn't have ships in the first place.

blocks.source: 流用はこれに留まらず、クリア後はさらに重要な箇所を流用曲に頼ってしまっている。
blocks.translation: The reuse doesn't stop there; after clearing the game, even more important scenes rely on borrowed music.

blocks.source: ストーリー、システム、グラフィック――と、本作には各方面で過去作を超える意気込みが感じられた。その中で音楽だけが白旗を上げているように思えて仕方なかった。
blocks.translation: In terms of story, systems, and graphics――this game conveyed an ambition to surpass its predecessors in every area. I couldn't help feeling that music alone had raised the white flag.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８がそうしていたように、せめて、アレンジぐらいはして欲しかったなあ……と、個人的には思った。
blocks.translation: As Dragon Quest VIII did, I personally wish they had at least arranged the tracks…

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Assessment

blocks.source: 元々、斬新さよりも手堅い造りに定評があるシリーズで、今作はその期待に応えられる出来だと思う。
blocks.translation: This series has always been known for its solid craftsmanship rather than its originality, and I think this game lives up to those expectations.

blocks.source: 作品の雰囲気は、グラフィックや演出力の高さもあってＤＱ８の正当後継といった印象を受けた。「ＤＱ８は楽しかったけど、ＤＱ９は物足りない」という人には間違いなくオススメできる。
blocks.translation: The game's atmosphere, along with its impressive graphics and direction, gave me the impression of being a true successor to Dragon Quest VIII. I can recommend it without hesitation to anyone who thought “Dragon Quest VIII was fun, but Dragon Quest IX was unsatisfying.”

blocks.source: 正直、安定して面白い作品になるだろうとは予想していたけど、それよりもずっと楽しめた。特に本編のストーリーがお気に入りで、今になってドラクエにこれだけ熱中できるとは予想外だった。
blocks.translation: Honestly, I expected it to be a consistently enjoyable game, but I enjoyed it far more than that. I especially loved the main story, and I never expected to become this absorbed in Dragon Quest at this point in my life.

blocks.source: ドラクエの最高傑作論争は３が優勢で、４や５がそれに追随しているのが一般的な評価だろうか。けれど、本作はそれらにも立派に肩を並べられる水準だと思う。
blocks.translation: In the debate over the greatest Dragon Quest game, III probably has the edge, with IV and V generally regarded as close behind. However, I think this game is fully worthy of standing alongside them.

blocks.source: 個人的には『ロードや戦闘テンポの悪さ』『音楽』『クリア後のイベントの薄さ』辺りの不満がなければ、迷いなくシリーズ最高傑作と断言していた。
blocks.translation: Personally, if I hadn't had complaints about “loading times and poor battle pacing,” “the music,” and “the lack of post-game events,” I would have declared it the best game in the series without hesitation.

blocks.source: 話を聞く限り、おまけ要素や快適性では３ＤＳ版に軍配が上がるらしい。プレイ時間も３ＤＳ版（特に２Ｄモード）のほうが大幅に減るはず。
blocks.translation: From what I've heard, the 3DS version apparently wins out in terms of bonus content and convenience. The playtime should also be considerably shorter in the 3DS version, especially in 2D mode.

blocks.source: ただＰＳ４版のグラフィックや演出は素晴らしいものがあるので、それだけでもこちらを選んだことに満足できた。
blocks.translation: However, the PS4 version's graphics and presentation are excellent, and I was satisfied with choosing it for those alone.

blocks.source: ……と言いながら、３ＤＳ版もやってみたいという気持ちもあったりする。長い作品なので大変かもしれないけれど。
blocks.translation: …That said, part of me still wants to try the 3DS version. It may be difficult since it's such a long game, though.

parts.source: スクウェア・エニックス（公式）

texts.３ＤＳ版との同時発売だが、筆者はＰＳ４版でプレイ。ちなみに、前作に当たるオンライ: Although it was released simultaneously with the 3DS version, I played the PS4 version. Incidentally, I had not played the online DQX, which was the preceding title, so please keep that in mind as a premise.
texts.クエストを全てこなしながら、本編クリアまで６６時間。: It took 66 hours to clear the main story while completing every quest.
texts.さらには裏ボス撃破まで９０時間と、シリーズではＤＱ７以来のプレイ時間だった。サブ: It took 90 hours to defeat the superboss, making it the longest I had played in the series since DQ7. If you complete all the side events, you might be able to play for 100 hours. The map is vast, but the game also has more content than the similar DQ8.
texts.本編が呆気なく終わったＤＱ９と比較して、その倍ぐらいの規模はあるかも。正直言って: Compared with DQ9, whose main story ended rather abruptly, it may be about twice the size. To be honest, I never expected it to be this thoroughly developed.
texts.ストーリーとしては、久々となる主人公が勇者のドラクエ。それも今回は、序盤から主人: As for the story, this is the first Dragon Quest in a while with a Luminary protagonist. This time, it is explicitly established from the beginning that the protagonist is the Luminary. This kind of setup has not appeared since the NES version of DQ4.
texts.ＤＱ６以降、起伏の控えめなストーリーが続いていた本シリーズだけど、今回は印象の強: Although this series had continued with relatively low-key stories since DQ6, this time there were many memorable events.
texts.特に仲間達に関わるイベントが充実しており、魅力的な仲間達との冒険を演出してくれて: The events involving the companions in particular are substantial, creating an adventure with a captivating cast. There is the protagonist's dependable partner, Erik; the sisters Veronica and Serena, who each play important roles; and Sylvando, a flamboyant character who nevertheless shows great inner strength.
texts.……などなど、キャラクター性は過去のドラクエのどれよりも高い。王道のドラクエにし: …and so on. The characters are more distinctive than in any previous Dragon Quest. Unusually for a traditional Dragon Quest title, it has a story that keeps you wondering what will happen next.
texts.ネタバレを徹底的に避けていた甲斐もあって、本編後半の展開には驚かされた。本作では: Avoiding spoilers so thoroughly paid off, as I was surprised by the developments in the latter half of the main story. This part of the story left the strongest impression on me in this game.
texts.クリア後の裏面も相当な量がある。物語的に大きな伏線回収がなされるため、クリア後も: There is also a considerable amount of content after clearing the game. Since major story foreshadowing is resolved there, it could practically be considered part of the main story even after the credits.
texts.ただし、そこからは急激に水で薄めたような内容になるのが難点。一度クリアしたダンジ: The problem, however, is that the content suddenly becomes watered down from that point on. Many sections make you revisit dungeons you have already cleared, and the events suddenly become bland as well.
texts.ネタバレになるので詳しく書けないけれど、充実した本編との落差で少しばかり寂しい気: I cannot go into detail because it would be a spoiler, but the contrast with the substantial main story left me feeling a little lonely. I was excited when entering the post-game story because of the epic developments, though…
texts.何はともあれ、真エンドの演出はシリーズファンをうならせるものがある。性質上、今回: In any case, the presentation of the true ending is sure to impress series fans. By its nature, the story cannot really be considered finished this time unless you defeat the superboss.
texts.進化してはいるけれど、いつものドラクエ。昔ながらのコマンド式。: It has evolved, but it is still the Dragon Quest you know. The traditional command-based system.
texts.古臭いという意見もあるけれど、ドラクエはこれでよいと思う。: Some people may consider it outdated, but I think Dragon Quest is fine this way.
texts.例えば、アクション式だと主人公一人しか操作できないことが多い。: For example, action-based systems often allow you to control only the protagonist.
texts.対して、コマンド式は仲間全員へ指示できるため、細かい戦術も可能となる。仲間を操作: By contrast, a command-based system lets you give orders to all your companions, enabling detailed tactics. Being able to control your companions also makes it easier to grow attached to them.
texts.また、リアルタイム性がないため、気を抜いて気楽にできることも大きい。作戦を指示し: Also, since it is not real-time, it is much easier to play casually without having to stay constantly focused. You can give orders to the AI and let it handle things, or control the characters yourself—the play style is up to you.
texts.そう考えてみれば、古典的でありながら、意外と今の時代に合っているような気もしない: When you think about it that way, it is surprisingly well suited to the modern era despite being so classic.
texts.……というように、コマンド式を愛好する側から擁護してみた。: …That is how I defended the command-based system from the perspective of someone who enjoys it.
texts.変わったところでは、コマンド入力と行動がターンでまとめてではなく、一人ずつ実行さ: One change is that command input and actions are now carried out one character at a time instead of being grouped together into a single turn.
texts.どうやらＰＳ４版だけの仕様らしく、最初はこれにとまどった。: Apparently this is a feature exclusive to the PS4 version, and it confused me at first.
texts.「まさか、ＣＴＢか何かになって、ターン制ではなくなったのか？」: "Surely it has become some kind of CTB system, meaning it is no longer turn-based?"
texts.と、疑って検証してみたけれど、やっぱり行動順序はターン制のままだった。: I suspected as much and tested it, but the order of actions was still turn-based after all.
texts.相変わらず行動順序にランダム性があるため、運が悪いと連続でボスの攻撃を喰らってし: Since the order of actions remains random, bad luck can sometimes leave you taking consecutive attacks from a boss. I found the rules in this area a little difficult to understand.
texts.また、ダメージを受けてターンが回ってくると、確率でキャラが『ゾーン』という強化状: Also, when a character takes damage and their turn comes around, they have a chance of entering an enhanced state called “Zone.”
texts.さらに複数人がゾーン状態になれば『れんけい』が使える。……が、これらはランダム性: Furthermore, when multiple characters are in Zone, you can use “Pep Powers.” …However, these are highly random and difficult to incorporate into your tactics. Deliberately activating them in difficult situations such as boss battles is extremely challenging. Even if you can incorporate them into your strategy, it probably will not be until quite late in the game.
texts.今回からは、レベルアップ時にＨＰＭＰが全快する仕様になっている。: Starting with this game, HP and MP are fully restored when you level up.
texts.また、フィールドやダンジョンの要所にはキャンプ地点があり、そこでも回復が可能にな: There are also camps at key locations in fields and dungeons, where you can recover as well. Camps are very convenient because they also offer facilities such as saving.
texts.そのため、パーティの消耗は今までのシリーズ作品よりかなりゆるい。ありがたいといえ: As a result, the party's attrition is much less severe than in previous games in the series. It is certainly welcome, but it also tends to encourage a blunt play style in which you unleash powerful attacks in every battle.
texts.ＤＱ８の錬金に代わって今作には『不思議な鍛冶』がある。それで装備を作成できること: Instead of DQ8's alchemy, this game has the “Fun-Size Forge.” Since you can use it to create equipment, money is also less likely to run short.
texts.それらもあって、序盤～中盤と難易度は低め。今回はボス戦の経験値が多めなので、レベ: Because of these features, the difficulty is relatively low in the early to middle portions of the game. Boss battles provide a generous amount of experience this time, so I was able to progress without grinding levels.
texts.もっとも、難易度は比較的低いという程度でＳＦＣ版ＤＱ３やＤＱ９よりは難しいはず。: That said, “relatively low” is all that can be said about the difficulty; it should still be harder than the SFC version of DQ3 and DQ9.
texts.さらには、本編後半からはボス敵の攻撃が激しくなってくる。三回攻撃や全体状態異常を: Furthermore, boss attacks become more intense in the latter half of the main story. They routinely unleash three attacks or status ailments affecting the entire party, making things quite difficult. In Dragon Quest especially, it is hard to completely prevent status ailments, so battles can sometimes come down to luck.
texts.今作の不満点の一つとして、戦闘テンポが挙げられる。: One of the game's shortcomings is its battle tempo.
texts.今時のＲＰＧにしては戦闘がゆったりしていて、ＤＱ８の時代から余り進歩が見られない: The battles are sluggish for a modern RPG, showing little progress from the days of DQ8.
texts.戦闘開始まで７秒。ＰＳ３以降のＲＰＧとしてはやや長い。: Seven seconds until the battle starts. That's rather long for an RPG from the PS3 era onward.
texts.敵と距離があると、攻撃する度にノロノロと敵へ近づく。: When there is some distance from an enemy, the character slowly approaches it each time they attack.
texts.呪文や特技には微妙な溜めのモーションがある。特に『ぶんまわし』のような単純な技に: Spells and Techs have subtle charge-up animations. Even for simple abilities like “Whirlwind,” isn't a charge-up animation lasting several seconds excessive?
texts.防御して次ターンが回ってきた時にいちいち「守りをといた」のメッセージ。: Whenever the next turn comes around after defending, there is an unnecessary “Dropped their guard” message.
texts.ＨＰ・ＭＰ自動回復だと毎ターンメッセージを待たされる。: With automatic HP and MP recovery, you have to wait for a message every turn.
texts.全体的に、いちいち行動が終わるまで待つのは時代遅れ感が否めない。: Overall, having to wait for every action to finish feels undeniably outdated.
texts.例えば、通常攻撃の速度を比較すると、こんな感じ。: For example, comparing the speed of normal attacks, it looks like this.
texts.システムは古いままでよいと言ったけれど、ここは頑張って欲しかった。今はグラフィッ: I said it was fine for the system to remain old-fashioned, but I wish they had made more of an effort here. These days, there are plenty of RPGs with beautiful graphics that have a better pace than this.
texts.というか、ＰＳ２版ＤＱ５の時点ではテンポ良すぎて気持ち悪いレベルだったのに、なん: In fact, the PS2 version of DQ5 was already at an almost uncomfortably fast pace, so why has it regressed…?
texts.余談。ここまで検証していて気づいたけれど『フリー移動バトル』モードのほうがテンポ: As an aside, while testing this, I noticed that the “Free Movement Battle” mode seems to have a slightly faster pace… For some reason, it became possible to skip messages such as “Dropped their guard” and “Automatic HP and MP recovery.” This may be because it is programmed to process them concurrently.
texts.ともあれ、昨今のゲームはあれこれと複雑なシステムを組み込んだ結果、逆に面白さが迷: In any case, my impression is that many modern games have incorporated various complicated systems and, as a result, have lost sight of what makes them fun. Compared to those, Dragon Quest’s appeal is very straightforward. This title, too, is a solid and enjoyable experience.
texts.その他ゲームバランスについて細かいこと。: A few other details about the game balance.
texts.メラ・ヒャド系呪文が微妙に弱い。敵の耐性の関係もあってか、単体攻撃のメラゾーマよ: Mer and Hyado-type spells are slightly weak. Perhaps because of enemy resistances, I feel that the overall-damage spell Ionazun has a higher expected value than the single-target spell Merazoma. Even though their MP costs are not significantly different…
texts.敵の強さと経験値が釣り合ってないことが多い。基本的に少数で出現する巨大な強敵より: Enemy strength and experience points are often poorly balanced. In general, it is more efficient to target the weak enemies that appear in groups than the gigantic, powerful enemies that appear in small numbers. This has also occurred in previous games in the series, but it stood out especially this time because there are so many large, powerful enemies.
texts.主人公の最強剣技が案外弱く、中盤で覚えられる技にすら負けているのはどうなのか。: The protagonist’s strongest sword technique is surprisingly weak, even losing out to techniques learned midway through the game. How does that make sense?
texts.ボス戦の経験値が多めなのはよいけど、死んでいるキャラは経験値が入らない。控えのキ: It is good that boss battles provide a generous amount of experience, but dead characters do not receive any. There is even an odd reversal where reserve characters are more likely to level up.
texts.選んだスキルと隣接したスキルが解放されていくパネル形式。: A panel-based system in which selected skills and adjacent skills are unlocked.
texts.ＤＱ８のスキルマスターの発展系だが、それよりもスキルの数は豊富。ＦＦ１０のスフィ: It is an evolution of DQ8’s Skill Master system, but it offers a greater variety of skills. It is similar to the Sphere Grid in FF10.
texts.例えば、カミュは『片手剣』『短剣』『ブーメラン』『かみわざ』の四通りのスキルがあ: For example, Camus has four skill paths: “One-Handed Swords,” “Knives,” “Boomerangs,” and “Nimbleness.”
texts.単体攻撃が強力だが、全体攻撃ができない『片手剣』: “One-Handed Swords,” with powerful single-target attacks but no way to attack groups
texts.強力な全体攻撃が可能だが、硬い敵が苦手な『ブーメラン』: “Boomerangs,” which allow powerful group attacks but are ineffective against heavily armored enemies
texts.というように選んだスキルによって、成長の方向性が変わってくる。パーティ編成とスキ: Thus, the direction of growth changes depending on the skills you choose. Depending on your party composition and skills, it is easier to express individual player preferences than in DQ8.
texts.スキルは中盤～後半辺りからリセットも可能。: Skills can also be reset from around the middle to the latter half of the game.
texts.ＤＱ８ではやり直しができなかったため、地雷スキルを選ぶと大きく不利になったが、今: In DQ8, you could not redo your choices, so selecting a bad skill put you at a major disadvantage. This time, there is less need to worry about that. It is helpful that resetting costs only a small amount of money (G).
texts.色々と快適にプレイさせるための工夫がされている。: Various measures have been implemented to make the game more comfortable to play.
texts.メニューを開いて□ボタンを押すだけで、『ほぼまんたん』で自動的に回復してくれる。: Simply open the menu and press the □ button to automatically recover using “Almost Full.”
texts.地図画面や仲間との会話で、行き先を逐一教えてくれる。: The map screen and conversations with party members explain your destination every step of the way.
texts.シンボルエンカウントなので敵を避けやすい。: Because encounters are symbol-based, it is easy to avoid enemies.
texts.メニュー画面の操作が洗練されていて動作も軽快。: The menu controls are polished, and the interface is responsive.
texts.特に『ほぼまんたん』は非常に便利。既存シリーズの『まんたん』よりも賢くやってくれ: “Almost Full” is especially convenient. It handles things more intelligently than the existing series’ “Full Recovery,” so there is little need to worry about MP consumption. It frees you from the routine healing chores typical of RPGs all at once.
texts.気になるロード時間だが、これはＤＱ８の時代より悪化している。ゲーム機は二世代も進: As for the loading times, which are a concern, they are worse than in the era of DQ8. Game consoles should have advanced by two generations, yet it seems players still have not been freed from loading hell…
texts.空の乗り物へ乗るには２５秒、降りるのに十数秒。: Twenty-five seconds to board a flying vehicle, and more than ten seconds to get off.
texts.ただし、マップ内へ一度入ってしまえば細かいロードは少ない。少なくとも、民家の出入: However, once you enter a map, there are few minor loading pauses. At least entering and leaving houses does not trigger loading. There are even times when you can explore a town for several dozen minutes without loading once, so it may be relatively considerate.
texts.ロード回数を軽減するためか、ルーラがダンジョン内でも使用可能になっている。（ＰＳ: Perhaps to reduce the number of loading screens, Zoom can also be used inside dungeons. (Apparently this may be limited to the PS4 version.) It is also convenient that you can Zoom directly to campsites in various locations.
texts.また、マップは広めだが、ＤＱ８よりは全体的に抑えられている。ただし、移動速度は遅: The maps are fairly large, but overall more restrained than in DQ8. However, movement speed is on the slow side and towns have complex layouts, so I think many people will find it tiring. Vehicles can be used in the field, so it is not much of a problem there, but getting around towns can be fairly demanding.
texts.特に今回はメダル王に当たる施設が微妙に遠い。メダルを渡しに行くのにルーラから合算: This time in particular, the facility corresponding to the Medal King is somewhat far away. I wish they had done something about the fact that going to hand over medals could take a full minute, including the time from using Zoom.
texts.今作もＤＱ９から引き続きクエストが存在する。: This game also continues the quest system introduced in DQ9.
texts.内容としては、ＤＱ９のように目立って面倒なものは控えめ。攻略情報なしでも大半はど: In terms of content, there are relatively few conspicuously tedious quests like those in DQ9. I managed to complete most of them without a walkthrough. …However, a few became troublesome enough that I had to rely on one. Because the maps are large, overlooking something you need to find can become quite a hassle.
texts.『れんけい』によって特定の敵を倒せ: Defeat a specific enemy using “Pep Powers”
texts.同じ敵を何度も倒せば登場する転生モンスターを倒せ: Defeat a re-incarnated monster that appears after defeating the same enemy repeatedly
texts.カジノのルーレットでジャックポットを当てろ: Hit the jackpot at the casino roulette
texts.この三種類は特に面倒だった。いずれも運の要素が絡んでくるため、当たりを引くまで繰: These three were particularly troublesome. Since luck is involved in all of them, you have to repeat them until you get the desired result. The battle-related ones are also tedious because the pacing isn't very good.
texts.その他、気になった点としては……: Other points that caught my attention were…
texts.マップ上で○ボタンで魔物にアタックすると有利になるが、乗り物上からできない。: Attacking monsters with the ○ button on the map gives you an advantage, but you can't do it while riding a vehicle.
texts.魔物に対して遠距離から○ボタンを押せば、ボウガンで敵をおびき寄せることができる。: Pressing the ○ button from a distance while facing a monster lets you lure it with a crossbow. …However, this frequently goes off accidentally, such as when you misinput an attack. In the first place, I feel the crossbow itself is unnecessary.
texts.明らかに格下のザコに対しても逃走に失敗する。: You can even fail to escape from clearly inferior small fry.
texts.船だけは旧来のランダムエンカウント。しかも出現率が高め。: Only the ship uses the old random encounters. What's more, the encounter rate is rather high.
texts.後はストーリーに関しても書いたけれど、クリア後の密度の低さは如何ともしがたい。: As I also mentioned regarding the story, there is unfortunately no way around how sparse the post-game content is.
texts.イベントの密度、ほどほどの敵の強さ、新しい敵とダンジョン……。そういったものが合: The density of events, enemies of moderate strength, new enemies and dungeons… I think Dragon Quest's appeal is built from these elements coming together.
texts.本編に関してはそれらが申し分なく発揮されていた。: In the main story, these elements were all delivered flawlessly.
texts.急激に強くなる敵に苦しめられる: You struggle against enemies that suddenly become much stronger
texts.見たことのある敵やダンジョンが再登場する: Enemies and dungeons you've already seen reappear
texts.というように、どうしてもモチベーションが下がってしまう。: As a result, your motivation inevitably drops.
texts.今回は裏面が明確にストーリーへ組み込まれているため、ストーリー重視のプレイヤーも: Since the post-game is clearly incorporated into the story this time, even players who prioritize the story can't simply ignore it.
texts.本編と同じような勢いのまま、終われたら理想だったのに――と、個人的には思ってしま: Personally, I couldn't help thinking that it would have been ideal if it had ended with the same momentum as the main story――.
texts.事前情報の段階だと、キャラはパッとしない印象があったのだけど、実際に動いていると: Based on the pre-release information, the characters had struck me as rather unremarkable, but seeing them actually in motion, they were more appealing than I expected. Veronica in particular is extremely expressive, and her subtle facial expressions are a lot of fun.
texts.大ガラス、フロッガー、リップス、おばけキノコ、ドロル、ももんじゃ、マムーとモンス: The monster selection is nostalgic, with Great Ravens, Floggers, Lips, Walking Mushrooms, Drohls, Momonjas, and Mamu.
texts.モンスターズなどの外伝を除けば、単一作品にしか登場しない魔物の再登場が多い。: Aside from spin-offs such as Dragon Quest Monsters, many monsters that appeared in only one particular game have returned.
texts.２以来の再登場となるスモークなんかは、今の技術で表現したらこうなるんだというのを: Smoke, returning for the first time since II, showed me what it would look like rendered with modern technology.
texts.ドラゴンやクラーゴンなど、旧作では小さなドットだったモンスターが迫力ある姿になっ: It was nice to see monsters such as dragons and Kragons, which were just tiny sprites in the older games, become imposing creatures.
texts.一説によると、ＤＱ１０からの流用が多いらしいけれど、初見の身にとっては大いに感激: Apparently, many of them were reused from Dragon Quest X, but as someone seeing them for the first time, I was deeply impressed.
texts.もっとも、本作オリジナルモンスターは乏しいし、後半は同じ魔物の使い回しが目立つの: That said, the game has few original monsters, and the reuse of the same monsters becomes especially noticeable in the latter half, which is a drawback…
texts.西洋風、和風、琉球風――と町の種類も様々。: The towns also come in a variety of styles: Western, Japanese, Ryukyuan, and more――.
texts.今時、これよりグラフィックの質が高い作品はいくらでもあるけれど、こちらはバリエー: These days, there are plenty of games with better-quality graphics, but this game's strength lies in its variety. More than anything, I was happy to be able to experience the warm world of Dragon Quest with high-quality graphics.
texts.以前プレイした某洋ゲ―はグラフィックは綺麗なのだけど、雰囲気は暗いし、同じような: I remember playing a certain Western game before that had beautiful graphics, but its atmosphere was gloomy, and I grew tired of seeing nothing but similar enemies and terrain. I hope the strengths of JRPGs like this continue to be valued.
texts.フィールド曲、戦闘曲、町の曲、ダンジョン曲と、無難なすぎやま節といった感じ。強い: The field, battle, town, and dungeon music all have a safe, conventional Sugiyama feel. They don't leave a strong impression, but they are consistently solid.
texts.その中では、シルビアのテーマとして流れるパレード曲だけが、悪目立ちしていてちょっ: Among them, only the parade music played as Sylvia's theme stands out in a bad way and may be a little grating.
texts.新曲で最もよかったのは、要所で流れるハープ曲。特にセーニャに関わるシーンが印象深: The best of the new songs is the harp piece that plays at key moments. The scenes involving Serena in particular left a strong impression. Until around the middle of the game, I thought of her as “the less prominent of the sisters,” but she turned out to be more of a heroine than I expected, which was nice.
texts.ただ、今作は音楽の使い回しが多くて、新曲の印象がとにかく薄い。集大成ということも: However, this game reuses so much music that the new songs leave virtually no impression. Perhaps because it is intended as a culmination of the series, one of its defining characteristics is how much music it borrows from previous games.
texts.なつかしさは感じられるし、場面に合っていることが多いのも確か。久しぶりに聞いた人: It certainly evokes nostalgia, and it is also true that the music often suits the scenes. Those hearing it again after a long time will probably find many moments to be deeply moving.
texts.そこまではいいのだけど、まさかゲームの要となる箇所までも、過去作の流用ばかりだと: Up to that point, it was fine, but I never expected even the game's key moments to rely almost entirely on music borrowed from previous titles.
texts.一例を挙げれば、本作の船の曲『海図を広げて』は元々ＤＱ４に使われていた曲。ＤＱ９: For example, this game's ship theme, “Spread Out the Sea Chart,” was originally used in Dragon Quest IV. Since it was also used in Dragon Quest IX, that means two consecutive games have lacked an original ship theme. It may be a masterpiece, but it is a shame that there is no such thing as “Dragon Quest XI's ship theme.”
texts.※ちなみにＤＱ１０はそもそも船がないらしいです。: ※Incidentally, it seems Dragon Quest X doesn't have ships in the first place.
texts.流用はこれに留まらず、クリア後はさらに重要な箇所を流用曲に頼ってしまっている。: The reuse doesn't stop there; after clearing the game, even more important scenes rely on borrowed music.
texts.ストーリー、システム、グラフィック――と、本作には各方面で過去作を超える意気込み: In terms of story, systems, and graphics――this game conveyed an ambition to surpass its predecessors in every area. I couldn't help feeling that music alone had raised the white flag.
texts.ＤＱ８がそうしていたように、せめて、アレンジぐらいはして欲しかったなあ……と、個: As Dragon Quest VIII did, I personally wish they had at least arranged the tracks…
texts.元々、斬新さよりも手堅い造りに定評があるシリーズで、今作はその期待に応えられる出: This series has always been known for its solid craftsmanship rather than its originality, and I think this game lives up to those expectations.
texts.作品の雰囲気は、グラフィックや演出力の高さもあってＤＱ８の正当後継といった印象を: The game's atmosphere, along with its impressive graphics and direction, gave me the impression of being a true successor to Dragon Quest VIII. I can recommend it without hesitation to anyone who thought “Dragon Quest VIII was fun, but Dragon Quest IX was unsatisfying.”
texts.正直、安定して面白い作品になるだろうとは予想していたけど、それよりもずっと楽しめ: Honestly, I expected it to be a consistently enjoyable game, but I enjoyed it far more than that. I especially loved the main story, and I never expected to become this absorbed in Dragon Quest at this point in my life.
texts.ドラクエの最高傑作論争は３が優勢で、４や５がそれに追随しているのが一般的な評価だ: In the debate over the greatest Dragon Quest game, III probably has the edge, with IV and V generally regarded as close behind. However, I think this game is fully worthy of standing alongside them.
texts.個人的には『ロードや戦闘テンポの悪さ』『音楽』『クリア後のイベントの薄さ』辺りの: Personally, if I hadn't had complaints about “loading times and poor battle pacing,” “the music,” and “the lack of post-game events,” I would have declared it the best game in the series without hesitation.
texts.話を聞く限り、おまけ要素や快適性では３ＤＳ版に軍配が上がるらしい。プレイ時間も３: From what I've heard, the 3DS version apparently wins out in terms of bonus content and convenience. The playtime should also be considerably shorter in the 3DS version, especially in 2D mode.
texts.ただＰＳ４版のグラフィックや演出は素晴らしいものがあるので、それだけでもこちらを: However, the PS4 version's graphics and presentation are excellent, and I was satisfied with choosing it for those alone.
texts.……と言いながら、３ＤＳ版もやってみたいという気持ちもあったりする。長い作品なの: …That said, part of me still wants to try the 3DS version. It may be difficult since it's such a long game, though.
